entities.summary: This page contains information for applications at the German Consulate-General Karachi for skilled workers with vocational qualifications.
eligibility: Valid employment contract with a company in Germany
Vocational qualification recognized by the competent German authority
application_process: Familiarize yourself with the visa category and its requirements
Prepare your visa application as explained in the checklist
important_notes: Applications at the German Embassy Islamabad are handled via the Consular Services Portal
